summary: Wellgistics Health, Inc. via its subsidiary Wellgistics, LLC entered into a Forbearance Agreement with Marco Capital, Inc. on May 1, 2026, acknowledging ~$1.77M in outstanding obligations under a Loan and Security Agreement. MCI agreed to forbear from exercising remedies until June 15, 2026, conditioned on bi-weekly $50K payments and potential application of future financing proceeds to repayment. Interest accrues at Term SOFR + 11.5% from May 5, 2026. This is a debt restructuring/forbearance, not an equity special situation. Watch for any default or refinancing risk.
